ppe_note: Firepower 900 is a Schedule 6 poison: impervious elbow gloves and a face shield when you pour it. Buff-It has no SDS on file: goggles.

Delta T 2.0 at 7, 2.9 at 9, 4.6 by noon. ESE 7–9 km/h with gusts under 22 till 1 pm, so drift goes west. Southerly 20 gusting 35 from 4 pm: be finished by then. Stop if it gusts over 30 or blows toward a fairway, tee or green

flags.t: Elevated rate: Firepower 230 mL/ha is 207 g/ha haloxyfop
flags.d: More than double the 90 g/ha of the earlier rough tanks. It's the bottom of the haloxyfop 520 labels' rate for established couch (400–800 mL/ha of the 520 = 208–416 g/ha). Glasshouse work halved tall fescue regrowth at about 4 g/ha and red fescue at about 40 g/ha, so keep it on the thick patches.
flags.s: Genfarm Haloxyfop 520 label · Stoltenberg et al. 1989, Weed Science 37:512

flags.t: Decontaminate the 5800 before anything else goes in it
flags.d: The 5800 sprays couch fairways and greens. Tank cleaner and a triple rinse through tank, boom and filters. It's on the post-application checklist.
If the 5800 carried the fairway Brek (propyzamide) + LuxiMax tank, its residue would hurt the fescue: tank cleaner and a triple rinse before this fill. It's the first rig check.
Any overlap or drift onto fairway edges will show. ESE 7–9 km/h this morning pushes drift to the west side of each rough.

flags.t: Boom setup: about 317 L/ha at 4 bar
flags.d: Toro's own colour code: Red is the 0.4 gpm size (1.51 L/min at 2.76 bar). At 4 bar that's about 1.82 L/min a nozzle; on 50 cm spacing at 6.9 km/h it's about 317 L/ha. The rate controller holds 300 near 3.6 bar.
Firepower 900 is registered for forestry and industrial grass control, not turf. Its label doesn't list fescue as tolerant.

flags.t: Buff-It: no label or SDS on file

facts: Thick ryegrass, couch and kikuyu patches only
